pages.text: RFTools Dimensions enables custom dimension creation — the backbone for Oblivion's Rift.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$(/bold) Oblivion's Rift (the primary endgame loop) uses RFTools Dimensions to generate procedural dungeon dimensions. Each Rift run is a unique dimension.$(br2)$(bold)Rift Keystone:$(/bold) Required to open a Rift portal. Crafted from Rift Shards (endgame currency) + boss materials.
$(bold)Dimension safety:$(/bold) Rift dimensions are single-use and collapse after the run timer expires. You will be ejected if you don't exit in time. Bring a warp scroll.
